narrative.overview: This system serves dense reading and inspection. Pale work surfaces separate architecture from white navigation and evidence panels. Familiar native controls keep attention on component identity, explicit transitions and source provenance.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained teal marks selection and the current modeled path.
Tonal surfaces and fine rules define work areas without decorative elevation.
Stable diagram positions preserve spatial memory through playback and folding.
Disclosures make detailed evidence available within the same reading workspace.

rules.name: The State Color Rule
rules.body: Teal communicates selection or current modeled state; it is not evidence that a business conclusion has been verified. Warning brown identifies unavailable or mismatched evidence and review qualifications.

rules.name: The Evidence Type Rule
rules.body: Monospace identifies code or structured metadata; responsibilities, explanations and actions stay in the UI face.

dos: Do preserve stable diagram positions while changing the visible depth.
Do retain clear keyboard focus and scroll affordances in bounded diagrams.
Do keep claim kinds, review currency and source targets explicitly labeled.
Do use disclosures to reveal exact evidence without leaving the workspace.
donts: Don't use current-step color as a synonym for verified business correctness.
Don't replace source-version qualifications with decorative success markers.
Don't add shadow elevation where tonal regions already express separation.
